Settlement_help_available: This amount is ready to withdraw because the customer has paid for the order and the cash has been collected from the driver. You can request it any time.
Settlement_help_pending: Amounts from orders not fully collected yet — goods are still in transit or at the hub, or the customer hasn't paid. They move to your available balance once the cash arrives.
Settlement_step_1: Tap (New withdrawal request), enter the amount and the payout method. The amount can't exceed your available balance.
Settlement_step_2: The request becomes (Pending) for admin review, and the amount is reserved from your available balance.
Settlement_step_3: Once approved it becomes (Approved); if rejected, the reserved amount returns to your available balance.
Settlement_step_4: You receive the cash via your chosen method, and after confirmation the request becomes (Paid).
Settlement_method_office: Visit the office and scan the request QR code to collect the cash in person.
Settlement_method_driver: A driver delivers the cash to you; confirm receipt by scanning the QR code.
Settlement_note_gross: The settlement amount is the full (gross) amount. Platform commission is charged at delivery time, not at withdrawal.
No_settlement_requests_hint: Once you have an available balance, tap (New withdrawal request) to withdraw your funds. All your past requests will appear here.
